text:
Dara: Kicking off a short thread to lock the design-partner plan for next month. Need: selection rubric, invite cadence, onboarding checklist, telemetry minimums, and concrete success gates. Who can take outreach?

Noah: I can run outreach + shortlist. Suggest cap = 6 partners (4 sandbox / 2 integration). Outreach window = 6 days, accept up to 6.

Hiro: Eng notes: hosted-first. For integrations reserve 1 dev-day each. Telemetry should be tiny. Minimal events: session_start, prompt_id, latency_ms, error_tag, feedback_flag. Example snip: `{"event":"latency_ms","value":190,"route":"/v1/chat"}`.

Elena: CS can support weekly 30m check-ins and async Looms. I'll own calendar invites and Miro. Recommend onboarding templates: quick-start (5 steps) and integration-runbook (1 page).

Dara: Rubric idea: score 1-5 on fit (40%), commitment reliability (30%), infra friction (-20%), metric signal (10%). Invert infra friction so lower effort scores higher. Keep review fast.

Noah: Add exclusion rule: if partner requires VPC peering or on-prem networking, move to private track and exclude from this cohort. Saves ops.

Hiro: Rollout: route all partners to hosted small variant first. If median latency > threshold for 48h, we can offer a larger hosted variant or temporary dedicated queue.

Elena: Success gates: onboarding completion >=80% within 72h; weekly active sessions >=2; cohort produces >=4 actionable tickets by week 4. Also mid-run 6-question pulse and NPS at exit.

Dara: Telemetry format: include `session_id` and `variant`. Keep schema examples in invite packet so partners can paste. Example payload: `{"event":"prompt","session_id":"<uuid>","variant":"rw-lite","latency_ms":172}`.

Noah: Incentives: small credits + 1:1 design review for integrations. No cash. Keep admin low.

Elena: Onboarding checklist for partners: 1) run sample 5-prompt set, 2) confirm telemetry delivered for 10 sessions, 3) save 3 failure Looms, 4) pass basic latency check. I'll produce templates.

Dara: Ops triggers: if any partner reports >20% increase in error rate or sustained 2x latency for 6h, open urgent triage and consider pausing. Also require legal ack for integrations (NDA/DPA).

Hiro: I'll provide a 2-file telemetry stub and a 1-page troubleshooting runbook by Thu. Noah: can you share shortlist by Mon?

Noah: Yes I'll share shortlist + invite copy by Mon EOD. Draft invite: "Hi <name>, we'd love your help shaping Redwood's private DP. Commitment: 4 weeks, weekly 30m syncs, brief async reports. Reply with track: sandbox or integration."

jill-bot: Calendar created: "DP Private Cohort Kickoff" Tue 10:00 PDT (organizer: Dara).

Dara: Action items: Noah: outreach + shortlist; Hiro: telemetry + runbook; Elena: onboarding templates + Miro. I'll assemble scoring sheet and run review Tue morning. Flag any objections here.

Elena: No objections. Will add sample prompts emphasizing hallucination and instruction-splitting edge cases.

Hiro: One small add: include `feedback_tag` values limited set (ui, hallucination, latency) to keep downstream filters simple.

Dara: Good call. Closing for now 44d updating central doc and tagging owners.
